sub_site: breast tumour and paired adjacent normal breast tissue

evidence.quote: During surgery, tumor tissue and adjacent normal breast tissue (at least 2 cm from the tumor margin) were aseptically collected

method.region: V2, V3, V4, V6-7, V8, V9 (Ion 16S Metagenomics Kit)

evidence.quote: Libraries targeting variable regions V2, V3, V4, V6–7, V8, and V9 were prepared using the 16S Metagenomics Kit
negative controls (blank extractions and PCR controls) were included throughout DNA extraction and sequencing procedures
Only samples passing quality control thresholds (minimum sequencing depth of 20,000 reads after filtering) were retained for downstream analysis.

notes: 22 patients, paired tumour + adjacent normal (44 tissue samples); stool not extracted. Controls 'included throughout DNA extraction and sequencing' - treated as sequenced, but no control results reported and no control-based decontamination; borderline with included_not_sequenced.
